about: Unicode text -> Shree-Lipi 7 (SHREE-GUJ7-xxxx) bytes, answered by Shree's own composers S8GujU64.dll and S8Guj764.dll for the same keystroke. bytes = the 7 composer's raw output, one hex byte per glyph code. kind: vendor-key = a key of a shipped .GUJ keyboard; canonical = probe in Shree's typing order (i-sign struck first, reph struck after base+sign); alt:* = the composer answer for a non-canonical typing order (kept, not used as truth); quirk:* = the Unicode composer wrote something other than the code sequence means, so the pair is misaligned (kept for evidence, not used).
